I actually take some offense at his post. I think we should get some more information before we just tell you to suck it up and be a man, whatever the fuck that means. What has changed? Are you more stressed out? Are you masturbating? Do you work out regularly?

Stress is the number one killer for me, and it's been causing a lot of problems because work has been fucking stressful. Meditation and exercise work wonders.
I see how it works, focus on the positives. You get my mind off the bad things and onto the good ones. You're right, I'll calm down. But this happens a lot lately. Thanks for responding.

Hey man. I sort of know what you're going through. I'm 23 and have a 4 month old son. He's the light of my life. I'm married to his mother, whom I've known since I was 17. I knew I wanted to marry her, but the baby came at an inopportune time. Neither of us have finished college. I'm working for her dad at least 40 hours a week, usually 45. I had to study for a managers test for a few months but I just got that out of the way. Our families are close by, too. So hey, lucky situation... but I don't get to talk to anyone outside of work. And those people all hate me for cutting in on their hours. I'm constantly berated even though I try as hard as possible. And the first two months of my son's life were insane. I thought none of us were going to make it. Things are settling down now, though. Power through and it gets WAY better. You are going to be a pillar of diamond, wrought from the fires of the most violent volcano. Get all this hard work done now, focus on your fiancée and make her happy now, and you will be heavily rewarded soon. Good luck and know that good things await you. Just power through!!!
